_what: PROPOSAL, not applied. problem_found.saved_map_today: 127 pages mapped to Next route files; 0 have markers or adapters. The only pattern is a catch-all '^/(.+)/?$' -> src/app/(marketplace)/[...unmatched]/page.tsx (the not-found route), so a blog URL such as /blog/<slug>/ resolves to that file.
problem_found.where_the_markers_are: marketing/src (Eleventy source): 64/64 blog posts carry SEOAI:INTERNALLINKS and SEOAI:EXPANDEDCONTENT; cookie-policy, privacy-policy, terms-of-service, faq, index and solutions carry BREADCRUMBSCHEMA, FAQ, SCHEMA and TITLE. The generated Next stubs (page.tsx, generated/*.ts) are regenerated from that source and must never be edited by hand.
problem_found.open_fixes_waiting: 16 pages: 10 blog posts (internal-links), 1 (expand-content), 3 legal pages (breadcrumbs), 1 solutions page (font-size), 1 marketplace home (faq).

keeps: The existing catch-all pattern stays LAST, so the marketplace (consumer) pages are unaffected.

depends_on: Edits to marketing/src only reach the live site once the generated Next pages are regenerated: the CI workflow in ci/generate-blog-pages.yml (or a person running the repo's sync and port scripts) must be in place first. The workflow currently only covers marketing/src/blog/**; it must be widened to the other source paths before non-blog fixes are shipped.
not_covered: The 21 hand-written Next marketplace pages (src/app/(marketplace)) have no markers and no adapters. 12 export Next metadata, so title/description/canonical could use the existing nextjs-metadata-export adapter (config only, as for Admizz). A body region such as the home page FAQ needs a marker pair placed where the design wants it: that is a design decision for the owner, and the only case that would need a (small) pull request into Zennly's repo.
